An Amateur Journalist

一名业余记者 · 180 词 · 2 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1Jane is a housewife who is delighted to work as an amateur journalist. It is difficult for her to balance her family and her work, and it is also unusual for the news department to depend on an amateur to cover crimes. But Jane is really gifted. It is admirable that she is seldom accused of making mistakes. And, eager to become more professional, she concentrates on her work and updates her skills from time to time.

2Once she is informed of a new case, she follows a regular process. First, she makes appointments to interview people involved in the case. To report accurately, she usually asks to record what they say. Meanwhile, a technically skilled colleague will assist her in taking photographs. Second, she assesses whether they are deliberately hiding the truth. If she is sceptical of their accounts, she will look into the case herself. Third, she writes thorough stories ahead of the deadline and submits them to the editor-in-chief, who polishes and approves every section. Finally, her stories will be published in different editions of their magazine.

一名业余记者

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1简是位家庭主妇，也很乐意当一名业余记者。在家庭和工作之间来回奔波，常让她左右为难。新闻部倚重一位业余记者报道刑事案件，也很少见。可是简确实有天分，难得有人指责她出错。她想变得更专业，平时就专心工作，也不时更新自己的知识。

2接到新案子的通知后，简通常这样工作。她先约见案件当事人，安排采访。为了写出准确的报道，她一般会要求把对方的话录下来，同时由一位技术熟练的同事协助拍照。接着，她判断受访者是否故意隐瞒真相。如果对他们的话有疑问，她就亲自调查。然后，她在截稿前写好详尽的报道，交给总编辑逐段润色和审定。最后，她写的报道会刊登在杂志的不同期次。
